description: This Java class, LocationDataManager, manages GPS location data by interfacing with a database and maintaining an in-memory cache. It provides methods to retrieve, add, and clear location points associated with specific days, identified via Calendar objects.

classes.name: LocationDataManager
classes.description: A class that wraps database access for GPS location data and provides caching to improve performance.

methods.name: LocationDataManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LocationDataManager with a database helper instance.

methods.name: getPoints
methods.description: Returns a list of LocationEntry objects for the day specified by the Calendar object, using cache if available.

methods.name: clearPoints
methods.description: Clears all location data for the day specified by the Calendar, removing entries from both cache and database.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a new LocationEntry point to the database and cache if it does not already exist.
